### R

```{r}
#| label: quasi-newton-step-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the quadratic function f over first coordinates from
#|   -0.4 to 0.6 and second coordinates from -0.2 to 1, a bowl-shaped surface
#|   whose lowest point is above the point (0.09, 0.64). Three markers lie on
#|   the surface. A blue circle at the origin is the starting point, a
#|   vermilion circle above (0.25, 0.5) is the iterate after one step, and a
#|   blue square above (0.09, 0.64) is the minimizer, at the bottom of the
#|   bowl.
qn_x_sf <- seq(-0.4, 0.6, length.out = 101)
qn_y_sf <- seq(-0.2, 1, length.out = 101)
qn_grid_sf <- tidyr::expand_grid(x = qn_x_sf, y = qn_y_sf)
qn_quad_sf <- 4 * qn_grid_sf$x^2 + 2 * qn_grid_sf$x * qn_grid_sf$y
qn_quad_sf <- 0.5 * (qn_quad_sf + 3 * qn_grid_sf$y^2)
qn_value_sf <- qn_quad_sf - qn_grid_sf$x - 2 * qn_grid_sf$y
qn_ny_sf <- length(qn_y_sf)
qn_z_sf <- matrix(qn_value_sf, nrow = qn_ny_sf)
qn_p_x_sf <- c(0, 0.25, 1 / 11)
qn_p_y_sf <- c(0, 0.5, 7 / 11)
qn_p_label_sf <- c("start", "after one step", "minimizer")
qn_p_color_sf <- c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#0072B2")
qn_p_symbol_sf <- c("circle", "circle", "square")
qn_pts_sf <- tibble::tibble(
  x = qn_p_x_sf,
  y = qn_p_y_sf,
  label = qn_p_label_sf,
  color = qn_p_color_sf,
  symbol = qn_p_symbol_sf
)
qn_pq_sf <- 4 * qn_pts_sf$x^2 + 2 * qn_pts_sf$x * qn_pts_sf$y
qn_pq_sf <- 0.5 * (qn_pq_sf + 3 * qn_pts_sf$y^2)
qn_pts_sf$z <- qn_pq_sf - qn_pts_sf$x - 2 * qn_pts_sf$y
qn_marker_sf <- list(color = ~color, size = 6, symbol = ~symbol)
qn_stops_sf <- c(0, 1)
qn_cols_sf <- c("#E5E5E5", "#808080")
qn_scale_sf <- list(qn_stops_sf, qn_cols_sf)
qn_eye_sf <- list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9)
qn_camera_sf <- list(eye = qn_eye_sf)
qn_xaxis_sf <- list(title = "first coordinate")
qn_yaxis_sf <- list(title = "second coordinate")
qn_zaxis_sf <- list(title = "f(x)")
qn_scene_sf <- list(
  xaxis = qn_xaxis_sf,
  yaxis = qn_yaxis_sf,
  zaxis = qn_zaxis_sf,
  camera = qn_camera_sf
)
qn_legend_sf <- list(orientation = "h")
plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = qn_x_sf,
    y = qn_y_sf,
    z = qn_z_sf,
    colorscale = qn_scale_sf,
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = qn_pts_sf,
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    z = ~z,
    text = ~label,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    marker = qn_marker_sf
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(scene = qn_scene_sf, legend = qn_legend_sf)
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: quasi-newton-step-3d-python
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| results: asis
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the quadratic function f over first coordinates from
#|   -0.4 to 0.6 and second coordinates from -0.2 to 1, a bowl-shaped surface
#|   whose lowest point is above the point (0.09, 0.64). Three markers lie on
#|   the surface. A blue circle at the origin is the starting point, a
#|   vermilion circle above (0.25, 0.5) is the iterate after one step, and a
#|   blue square above (0.09, 0.64) is the minimizer, at the bottom of the
#|   bowl.
import numpy as np
import plotly.graph_objects as go

qn_x_3d = np.linspace(-0.4, 0.6, 101)
qn_y_3d = np.linspace(-0.2, 1, 101)
qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d = np.meshgrid(qn_x_3d, qn_y_3d)


def qn_f_3d(x, y):
    return 0.5 * (4 * x**2 + 2 * x * y + 3 * y**2) - x - 2 * y


qn_pts_x_3d = np.array([0, 0.25, 1 / 11])
qn_pts_y_3d = np.array([0, 0.5, 7 / 11])
qn_pts_z_3d = qn_f_3d(qn_pts_x_3d, qn_pts_y_3d)
qn_marks_3d = [
    ("start", "#0072B2", "circle"),
    ("after one step", "#D55E00", "circle"),
    ("minimizer", "#0072B2", "square"),
]
fig = go.Figure(data=[
    go.Surface(
        x=qn_x_3d,
        y=qn_y_3d,
        z=qn_f_3d(qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d),
        colorscale=[[0, "#E5E5E5"], [1, "#808080"]],
        showscale=False,
        opacity=0.6,
        showlegend=False,
    ),
])
for i, (name, color, symbol) in enumerate(qn_marks_3d):
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter3d(
        x=[qn_pts_x_3d[i]], y=[qn_pts_y_3d[i]], z=[qn_pts_z_3d[i]],
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(color=color, size=4, symbol=symbol), name=name));
fig.update_layout(
    scene=dict(
        xaxis_title="first coordinate",
        yaxis_title="second coordinate",
        zaxis_title="f(x)",
        camera=dict(eye=dict(x=1.6, y=-1.6, z=0.9)),
    ),
    legend=dict(orientation="h"),
);
print("```{=html}\n" + fig.to_html(full_html=False, include_plotlyjs="cdn") + "\n```")
```

```{python}
#| label: quasi-newton-step-3d-python-static
#| echo: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| eval: !expr isFALSE(knitr::is_html_output())
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the quadratic function f over first coordinates from
#|   -0.4 to 0.6 and second coordinates from -0.2 to 1, a bowl-shaped surface
#|   whose lowest point is above the point (0.09, 0.64). Three markers lie on
#|   the surface. A blue circle at the origin is the starting point, a
#|   vermilion circle above (0.25, 0.5) is the iterate after one step, and a
#|   blue square above (0.09, 0.64) is the minimizer, at the bottom of the
#|   bowl.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

qn_x_3d = np.linspace(-0.4, 0.6, 101)
qn_y_3d = np.linspace(-0.2, 1, 101)
qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d = np.meshgrid(qn_x_3d, qn_y_3d)


def qn_f_3d(x, y):
    return 0.5 * (4 * x**2 + 2 * x * y + 3 * y**2) - x - 2 * y


qn_pts_x_3d = np.array([0, 0.25, 1 / 11])
qn_pts_y_3d = np.array([0, 0.5, 7 / 11])
qn_pts_z_3d = qn_f_3d(qn_pts_x_3d, qn_pts_y_3d)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d, qn_f_3d(qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d),
                color="grey", alpha=0.4)
ax.scatter(qn_pts_x_3d[0], qn_pts_y_3d[0], qn_pts_z_3d[0], marker="o",
           color="#0072B2", s=50, label="start")
ax.scatter(qn_pts_x_3d[1], qn_pts_y_3d[1], qn_pts_z_3d[1], marker="o",
           color="#D55E00", s=50, label="after one step")
ax.scatter(qn_pts_x_3d[2], qn_pts_y_3d[2], qn_pts_z_3d[2], marker="s",
           color="#0072B2", s=50, label="minimizer")
ax.set_xlabel("first coordinate")
ax.set_ylabel("second coordinate")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-graph) of the [quadratic function](algebra-exponentials.qmd#def-quadratic-polynomial) $f$ from @exm-quasi-newton-step,
the surface whose [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-set) are in @fig-quasi-newton-step.
The start $\vx^{(0)} = \vzero$ (blue circle),
the point $\vx^{(1)}$ reached after one [steepest-descent](#def-gradient-descent) step (vermilion circle),
and the [minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-global-minimizer) (blue square) at the bottom of the bowl are marked on the surface. <!-- check-term-links: allow -->

:::
